capabilities: Copy selections or notes as email-ready rich HTML with every style inlined
Rasterize Mermaid diagrams, charts, math and SVGs into embedded PNG images
Embed vault images as data URIs so they paste into the mail client
Write a chat-ready plain-text flavor with configurable glyphs for headings, lists and quotes
Run via command palette, right-click menu or ribbon button
extras: README documents per-client limitations (classic Outlook for Windows may not show data-URI images while composing; mobile degrades diagrams to placeholders) and notes that plain Cmd/Ctrl+C remains Obsidian's native copy. Author links to other plugins and a donation page.
problem: Markdown pastes into email and chat clients as raw syntax, and class-based HTML copy gets stripped because mail clients drop style blocks on paste.
summary: Copy command that turns selections or whole notes into email-ready rich text with inline styles plus a chat-ready plain-text flavor.
